In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.

In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.

Will Book G, page 112. Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.
